items.myth: The visa officer wants perfect English
items.detail: Answer directly in simple English. Your accent doesn't matter.

items.fact: Say it in your own words
items.detail: They sound rehearsed. Remember points, not lines.
Keep your documents ready, and be able to explain your plan too.

youtube.title: Do you need perfect English for a visa interview? Myth vs Fact
